summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K attaching its weekly press release detailing share repurchases under a buyback program announced April 16, 2026. During September 14-18, 2026, the company repurchased 500,000 Class B shares (ISIN SE0000108656) at a volume-weighted average price of SEK 99.5513, for total consideration of SEK 49,775,660. The program authorizes up to SEK 15,000,000,000 and runs from April 23, 2026 through March 31, 2027. Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE executes on Nasdaq Stockholm under MAR safe-harbour rules; treasury stock now totals 108,018,663 Class B shares.
